 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Another exciting MLS Matchday is upon us, with all eyes on Inter Miami as they take on FC Cincinnati . The Herons are looking to bounce back after a disappointing 2-0 defeat to the New York Red Bulls, a setback that pushed them down to second place in the Eastern Conference.
 In contrast, the Orange and Blue boosted their playoff hopes with a crucial win over D.C. United, keeping their postseason ambitions alive.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement One reason Inter Miami struggled against NYRB was that Lionel Messi started on the bench. From the opening whistle, the Herons struggled without their captain's determination and offensive playmaking.
 However, this matchday, the Argentine captain could come off the bench or start. It's a valid question, considering that, barring any unforeseen circumstances, Inter Miami will be competing for the MLS Cup.
 Is Lionel Messi playing tonight for Inter Miami against FC Cincinnati?
 Sep 20, 2026; Miami, Florida, USA; Inter Miami CF forward Lionel Messi (10) exits the field after the game against San Diego FC at Miami Freedom Park. Mandatory Credit: Sam Navarro-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect
 It's not unreasonable to suggest that, without the Argentine, the team coached by Kily Gonzlez is not as brilliant and lethal in attack. While it's true that you should never underestimate the quality of the players in Miami's squad, having Lionel Messi is an incredibly valuable asset for any coach.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement After missing out on a starting role in the previous match, Lionel Messi is expected to be back in the starting eleven as Inter Miami look to secure their playoff spot without delay. Facing a formidable and physical opponent, the expectation remains high for Messi to deliver his trademark brilliance.
 Remarkably, the Argentine icon is chasing three major achievements in MLS this season: the MVP award, the league's top scorer title, and the honor of leading in assists. For the greatest player of all time, these feats are well within reach.
 We are entering the final stretch of the MLS season, and "La Pulga" wants to keep breaking records and making history with Inter Miami, which makes every match crucial. Beyond being a born competitor, the Inter Miami captain is determined to win his second consecutive MLS Cup.
